dedupe_keys.name: epcra tier ii hazardous chemical inventory reports us facility chemical storage

description: Under sections 311 and 312 of the US Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act, facilities that must keep safety data sheets for hazardous chemicals report an annual inventory of those chemicals by 1 March to their state or tribal emergency response commission, local emergency planning committee and local fire department, using Tier I or Tier II forms. Reporting thresholds are 500 pounds or the threshold planning quantity for extremely hazardous substances, 10,000 pounds for other hazardous chemicals, and 75,000 or 100,000 gallons for gasoline and diesel at retail stations. The rules and the Tier2 Submit software are provided by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Coverage is national, facility by facility. The law requires the information to be made available to the public, free, but it is held by states and local committees, so access is by request or state portals, not a national download. Caveats: formats and access differ between states, and owners may withhold location information from public disclosure, with separate EPCRA rules on trade secrets. For simulation it shows which chemicals are stored at which plants, warehouses and utilities, key inputs for hazard exposure, Natech and emergency response models around industrial sites. It is related to the EPA Toxics Release Inventory and RMP map records in this catalogue.
